Juma does not have any change today, so he has decided to round all prices up to the nearest whole dollar. If Juma sells 910 pots of marigolds, 9 pots of petunias, and 143 pots of begonias, how much will he earn?

    *   Begonias: $374

    *   Petunias: 9 pots
